title: The fibre ring is a quotient of a localization
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\mathfrak p\subset A$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=A_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pA_{\mathfrak p}$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let $T=\varphi(A\setminus\mathfrak p)\subseteq B$ (a multiplicative subset), $B_{\mathfrak p}=T^{-1}B$ the ring of fractions $b/t$ ($b\in B$, $t\in T$, with $b/t=b'/t'$ iff $u(bt'-b't)=0$ for some $u\in T$), and $\mathfrak pB_{\mathfrak p}$ the ideal of $B_{\mathfrak p}$ generated by the elements $\varphi(a)/1$, $a\in\mathfrak p$. Then there is an isomorphism of $B$-algebras $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)\xrightarrow{\sim}B_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pB_{\mathfrak p}$; it sends $b\otimes\overline{a/s}$ ($a\in A$, $s\in A\setminus\mathfrak p$) to the class of $\varphi(a)b/\varphi(s)$.

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: `Ideal.Fiber.algEquivAux₁ p : p.Fiber S ≃ₐ[S] Localization (Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl) ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap S _) (Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) p)` (line 100; R = A, S = B, `p.Fiber S = p.ResidueField ⊗[R] S` (line 66) with the B-algebra structure on the right factor; `algebraMapSubmonoid S p.primeCompl` is T and the ideal is pB_p); precompose with `Algebra.TensorProduct.comm` (B ⊗[A] κ(p) ≃ κ(p) ⊗[A] B) to get the factor order of the node. `Ideal.Fiber.algEquivQuotient` (line 85) is the same isomorphism with pB_p written as the image of pA_p. The formula on b ⊗ a/s is forced: the map is a B-algebra map, hence A-linear, and φ(s) is a unit in B_p/pB_p. Source read 2026-10-10.
